about_the_game:
Adds a quest offering Pino's Hunter Attire, which boosts the number of items acquirable through harvesting/mining.

Adds quests offering DLC items in Exploration Mode to the Guild Quests at Shooting Starlight.

Quest added by clearing Chapter 3, Norma Arc.

"Quest

You got Hunter Attire."

Clear Reward

･Pino's Attire "Hunter Attire"

- Please be mindful of the number of items in your inventory. If items obtainable upon clearing a quest would go over your inventory limit, you won't be able to obtain them.

*The same quest is included with the Standard Edition (if pre-ordered) and the Deluxe Edition.

Please be aware that you can't undertake this quest twice.
